RENT AGREEMENT

This Rent Agreement is made at Pune on this 1st day of March 2026 between Mr. Anil Kulkarni, residing at Kalyani Nagar, Pune, Maharashtra 411006 (hereinafter called the "Landlord") and Ms. Sara Khan, residing at Baner, Pune, Maharashtra 411045 (hereinafter called the "Tenant").

1. The Landlord hereby lets to the Tenant Flat No. 402, Sunrise Residency, Baner, Pune, solely for residential purposes for a period of eleven (11) months commencing on 1 March 2026.

2. The Tenant shall pay a monthly rent of Rs. 45,000 on or before the fifth day of each calendar month. Any rent delayed beyond seven (7) days shall attract interest at 18% per annum, and the rent shall increase by 10% on renewal.

3. The Tenant has paid an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rs. 2,25,000. The Landlord may deduct any amount for damage, unpaid dues or repainting at his sole discretion, and any amount not refunded within sixty (60) days of vacating may be treated as forfeited.

4. Neither party may terminate this Agreement during the first six (6) months (the lock-in period). If the Tenant vacates during the lock-in period, the Tenant shall pay the rent for the balance of the lock-in period as liquidated damages.

5. After the lock-in period, either party may terminate this Agreement by giving thirty (30) days prior written notice.

6. The Tenant shall not sublet the premises, run a business from the premises, or keep pets without the prior written consent of the Landlord.

7. The Tenant shall indemnify the Landlord against all claims, losses and damages arising from the Tenant's use of the premises.

8. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Pune, Maharashtra shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of this Agreement.
